scale.source: Income Tax Act (Cap. 470) Third Schedule Head B para. 1: start of the 32.5 % band ('On the next Ksh. 3,600,000 | 32.5%' after 288,000 + 100,000 + 5,612,000 = 6,000,000; Kenya Law consolidation 2025-07-01)
scale.basis: Income Tax Act (Cap. 470) Third Schedule Head B para. 1: start of the 32.5 % band ('On the next Ksh. 3,600,000 | 32.5%' after 288,000 + 100,000 + 5,612,000 = 6,000,000; Kenya Law consolidation 2025-07-01). A statutory band threshold, not an average wage: 1 'AW' in scanner output = this amount of annual income.

registry_correction: Registry 'Income Tax Act (Cap. 470); personal relief; SHIF, NSSF, housing levy' confirmed: individual taxation (s. 45 repealed by Act 4 of 2023), annual bands 10/25/30/32.5/35 % (288,000 / 388,000 / 6,000,000 / 9,600,000), personal relief 28,800; since 27 Dec 2024 SHIF (2.75 %, min 300 a month) and the Affordable Housing Levy (1.5 %) are deductible (s. 15(2)(ac),(ae)), NSSF (6 % to the UEL) deductible as a registered-fund contribution (s. 22(8), s. 22A cap 360,000).
